title: Skimmer vs GorillaDesk (2026): Pool Route Pricing Compared
description: Skimmer vs GorillaDesk for pool routes: $1-$2 per pool vs $49-$149 per route, cost for 1-10 techs, chemical/LSI tools, QuickBooks, texting and trials.
h1: Skimmer vs GorillaDesk for pool service routes
body:
Skimmer and GorillaDesk both run pool routes, but they're built differently. Skimmer is pool-only software that charges per serviced location (each pool address you service that month), with unlimited techs and admins. GorillaDesk is a multi-trade route app (pest, pool, lawn) that charges per route, meaning per technician schedule, with unlimited users. Every number below comes from each vendor's own pages, checked on 2026-11-15 (Skimmer pricing, GorillaDesk pricing, GorillaDesk pool service page). If a vendor doesn't publish something, we mark it unknown.

{{table:skimmer,gorilladesk}}

Pricing models: per pool vs per route

  • Skimmer: Getting Started is $1 per serviced location per month, starting at $49/mo (includes 49 locations), and Skimmer pitches it at 0-49 pools a month. Scaling Up is $2 per serviced location, starting at $98/mo (includes 49 locations), for 50-1,000 pools. Enterprise (1,000+ pools) is custom priced. You're billed once a month per address no matter how many visits or bodies of water it has, and locations you don't service that month aren't billed. Annual pricing: unknown.
  • GorillaDesk: Basic $49/mo, Pro $99/mo and Growth $149/mo for the first route, billed monthly. Each extra route on Basic is +$50/mo for routes 2-3 and +$30/mo from route 4. Pro is +$50/mo per added route. Growth is +$100/mo for route 2 and +$50/mo each for routes 3-4, then 5 routes cost $499/mo total, plus $50/mo for each route after that. Admin, office and crew users are free. Only techs who run their own schedule need a route, and crews that ride together share one. A Yearly option gives one month free and is billed for the whole year up front. GorillaDesk is month-to-month with no setup fees and free data migration, and you can freeze your account in the off-season.

What the same pool route costs on each

We worked these out from the list prices above (USD per month, before tax, payment processing, texting and add-ons). The pools-per-tech numbers are example scenarios, not industry averages. Skimmer's Scaling Up price assumes $2 for every serviced location, with a $98 minimum. GorillaDesk assumes one route per tech.

The pattern: GorillaDesk's list price is lower for any full route, because it doesn't grow with your pool count. Skimmer only ties it at the very bottom: under 50 pools, Getting Started is $49/mo, the same as GorillaDesk Basic for one route. But the tiers aren't equal. GorillaDesk Basic doesn't include QuickBooks Online sync, the customer portal, online booking or Drive Matrix routing (those start on Pro), and its route optimization is capped at 25 stops at a time. Skimmer includes QuickBooks Online sync and a customer portal on every plan. Most pool routes that want accounting sync should compare Skimmer with GorillaDesk Pro, which still costs less per month once a tech has more than about 50 pools. Full price breakdowns: Skimmer pricing by pool count, GorillaDesk pricing by route, and pool service software cost for every pool app side by side.

Add-ons and texting

  • Skimmer: Service Texts are $0.029/message on Getting Started and unlimited on Scaling Up. Add-ons on every plan: AI Phone $99/mo, Marketing Suite $150/mo, Bookkeeping from $198/mo. CRM Integrations ($49/mo) and Google Calendar ($25/mo) are add-ons on Getting Started and Scaling Up, and both come included on Enterprise.
  • GorillaDesk: texting is a $5/mo SMS subscription (a local number that forwards to your main line) plus credit packs: $50 for 1,000 messages, $100 for 2,500 or $200 for 8,000. Credits never expire and are only used for outgoing texts.

Chemical readings and pool-specific features

This is the biggest gap. Skimmer is built only for pools. Scaling Up includes an LSI and dosing calculator powered by Orenda and a LaMotte integration. Skimmer's pricing page also lists Heritage and PoolCorp product sync, a shopping list, photo limits per visit (5 on Getting Started, 20 on Scaling Up) and required checklist items on Scaling Up. GorillaDesk's pool page says it handles chemical use records through material tracking and reporting (on Basic) and lets you build pool maintenance checklists. It doesn't mention an LSI or dosing calculator or test-kit integrations (unknown). If you want to log readings and get dosing suggestions in the app, see pool maintenance software, which compares those features across pool apps.

Routing and scheduling

Skimmer includes Route Builder on every plan. Route Optimization, the Schedule and recurring work orders come with Scaling Up. GorillaDesk Basic optimizes up to 25 stops at a time. Pro adds Drive Matrix routing, which uses real-time street routing and drive times, plus GPS tech tracking. Growth adds drive time shown on the schedule, Best Available Time suggestions and Job Magnet to pull nearby jobs together. For more route-focused options, see best pool route software and pool service scheduling software.

Billing, payments and QuickBooks

  • Skimmer: invoicing, bulk invoices, online payments, AutoPay, surcharging and a customer portal on every plan, plus QuickBooks Online sync on all three plans. Consumer financing through Sunbit is on Scaling Up. Card processing rate: unknown.
  • GorillaDesk: Stripe and Square for online and in-field payments (their rates), advanced invoice frequencies on Basic, plus a customer portal, Stripe/Square subscription billing and QuickBooks Online sync starting on Pro.

Other trades

If you also do pest control, lawn care or irrigation, GorillaDesk covers those under the same account. Pro adds device tracking and barcoding (traps, devices or equipment) and multi-dwelling units. Skimmer only handles pool service. See GorillaDesk vs Jobber and best pest control software if you run more than pools.

Trials and guarantees

Skimmer is running a promotion where new customers get the first month of Scaling Up free (up to 49 locations, through its promo link), plus a 30-day refund guarantee. GorillaDesk has a 14-day free trial with no credit card and no contract.

Which should you pick?

  • Pool-only route that wants LSI/dosing and LaMotte: Skimmer Scaling Up. {{aff:skimmer|See Skimmer plans}}
  • Lowest monthly price for full routes: GorillaDesk. Pro's $99 per route (+$50 per extra route) doesn't change with pool count, while Skimmer's $2/pool does. {{aff:gorilladesk|See GorillaDesk pricing}}
  • Seasonal or part-time route under 50 pools: close call. Skimmer Getting Started ($49 minimum, unserviced pools not billed) includes QuickBooks sync. GorillaDesk Basic is also $49 and lets you freeze your account in the off-season.
  • Pool plus pest or lawn work: GorillaDesk, since Skimmer is pool-only.

faq: Is GorillaDesk cheaper than Skimmer for pool service?

Usually, once a route is full. GorillaDesk is priced per route (Basic $49, Pro $99, Growth $149 for one route), while Skimmer Scaling Up is $2 per serviced location ($98/mo minimum). One tech with 70 pools costs $140/mo on Skimmer Scaling Up and $99/mo on GorillaDesk Pro. Under 50 pools, Skimmer Getting Started ($49/mo) matches GorillaDesk Basic. Prices checked 2026-11-15.
Does Skimmer or GorillaDesk charge per user?

Neither. Skimmer includes unlimited technicians and admins and bills per serviced location. GorillaDesk includes unlimited users and bills per route (technician schedule). Crews that ride together share one route.
Does GorillaDesk have an LSI or dosing calculator like Skimmer?

GorillaDesk's pool page talks about chemical use records (material tracking and reporting) and pool maintenance checklists, but doesn't mention an LSI or dosing calculator. Skimmer's Scaling Up plan includes an LSI and dosing calculator powered by Orenda and a LaMotte integration.
Do Skimmer and GorillaDesk sync with QuickBooks?
Both sync with QuickBooks Online. Skimmer includes it on all plans. GorillaDesk includes it on Pro ($99/mo per route) and up, but not on Basic.
Do Skimmer and GorillaDesk have free trials?
GorillaDesk has a 14-day free trial with no credit card. Skimmer currently offers the first month of Scaling Up free for new customers (promotion, up to 49 locations) and a 30-day refund guarantee.
Can I pause GorillaDesk or Skimmer in the off-season?

GorillaDesk says monthly subscribers can freeze their account if the business is seasonal. Skimmer doesn't bill locations you don't service in a given month, but you still pay the $49 or $98 plan minimum.
